correctness.rationale: The missing-incidence diagonal forces exactly one cross-cut edge for each chosen attribute; distinctness and counting are bijective. General claims follow from proofs, not computation.

value.rationale: The invariant is motivated by exponential Boolean suborder lower bounds on concept-lattice cardinalities. The theorem identifies an exact NP-complete graph parameter for its maximal dimension, gives a witness-refined polynomial for all dimensions, a sharp star equality and all-size paths/cycles transfer recurrence. These are structural explanations of natural objects, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
